params._implementation: Address of the deployed Slot implementation.
params._minSweep: Minimum gross balance required to trigger sweep.
params._tip: Flat caller bonus in 6-decimal USDC units.

params.feeRecipient: Receives the fee portion; must be non-zero when feeBps > 0.
params.maxReimbursement: Cap on a stranger sweeper's gas refund + tip                      (6-decimal USDC); must be >= tip.
params.merchant: Address that will receive swept USDC.
params.payRef: Off-chain payment reference; unique per merchant.

returns.slot: Address of the newly-deployed Slot clone.

params.slotAddresses: Array of Slot clone addresses to sweep.

createRequest(address,bytes32,uint16,add.notice: Create a payment request: deploy the Slot and record the amount,         label and expiry on-chain, attributed to msg.sender. Payment links         then only need the slot address, so they can't be edited.

createSlot(address,bytes32,uint16,addres.notice: Deploy a new Slot clone for (merchant, payRef).

implementation().notice: EIP-1167 implementation address.  All clones proxy to this.

minSweep().notice: Minimum gross balance (6-decimal USDC) required to sweep,         forwarded to every clone.

predict(address,bytes32).notice: Predict the deterministic address for (merchant, payRef)         without deploying. Returns the same address createSlot would produce.

requestsOf(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Slots created by `creator`, oldest first, paginated.

sweepMany(address[]).notice: Sweep a batch of Slot addresses. Each slot's sweep() is called         in a try/catch so one failing slot cannot block the rest.

tip().notice: Flat caller tip (6-decimal USDC) forwarded to every clone.

usdc().notice: ERC-20 USDC token address forwarded to every clone.
